prerequisites: Courses from the second year of the Common Industrial Branch Module

learning_outcomes.text: Select, write a technical report, and economically evaluate the electrical machines necessary for a given industrial installation.
Perform, analyze, and write a technical report on the most common tests carried out on the electrical machines studied in the course.
Deduce and apply the equivalent circuit of the electrical machines studied in the course.
Calculate and analyze parameters and operating characteristics of the electrical machines studied in the course.
Calculate, design, and write technical reports for the electrical machines studied in the course.

syllabus_topics: Chapter II. SYNCHRONOUS, PERMANENT MAGNET AND SWITCHED RELUCTANCE MOTORS
assessment_rules: The final grade for the ordinary call is calculated as: Final Grade = (0.85 x EX) + (0.15 x PL). No minimum grade is specified for the theoretical or practical blocks. In the extraordinary call, the evaluation consists of a single exam covering all course content, and the grade obtained in this exam (out of 10 points) will be the final grade. If there is doubt about authorship or unauthorized means (e.g., AI tools), students may be asked for an in-person defense.
